title: Cafe owners waste hours on manual inventory
content: I run a small coffee shop and I spend 6 hours every week counting stock in a spreadsheet. I have looked at inventory tools but they are all built for restaurants with 50+ seats and cost too much. I would pay for something simple that automates this manual data entry.

title: Freelancers struggle with weekly invoicing
content: Every week I lose an evening to invoicing by hand. My current workaround is a spreadsheet template and it keeps breaking when clients change their billing details. I already pay for an accounting tool but it does not handle my case.

title: Small shops cannot keep up with SNS posting
content: As a shop owner I know I should post to Instagram every day but I never find the time. I tried scheduling tools but writing the posts is the hard part, not scheduling them.
